## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das lässt mich nicht los.** — [das lesst mish nisht lohs] — *That won't let go of me. / I can't stop thinking about it.*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei dir.** — [ish bin gants by deer] — *I'm completely with you. / You have my full attention.*
3. **Es fügt sich alles zusammen.** — [es foogt zish ah-les tsoo-zah-men] — *Everything is falling into place.*
